packs.title: Gardens, Walls and Coast
packs.promise: Compare garden forms, castle defences, gallery choices and the western waterfront.

st: Visit La Concepción through its ordinary visitor entrance at Camino del Jardín Botánico 3. October–March opens 09:30–17:30; April–September 09:30–20:30. Mondays normally close, with published holiday exceptions; 25 December and 1 January close. Tickets are sold only at the arrival cashier: general €5.20, reduced €3.10 with the published eligibility and proof. Sunday free windows are October–March 14:00–17:30 and April–September 16:30–20:30. Under-16s must be with an adult. Check current gate notices; allow separate time for entry.

During a quiet independent visit, use the ordinary central paths near the entrance and historic garden. Choose three plants with contrasting leaf forms visible from the path; the outer forest circuit is not required.
Notice one difference in outline, one in arrangement and one in apparent texture. Read a name only if an actual label supplies it; do not guess a species.

After leaving a busy path, write three located observations and one relationship between them. Keep leaves, seeds and branches where they are; no organized group activity or staged photo report is required.

q.s: Let an observed relationship start an original response.
st: Enter the Centre Pompidou through valid ordinary semipermanent admission: general €7, reduced €4 under the published eligibility; qualifying free admission requires the applicable proof, and Sunday from 16:00 is free. Combined €9 admission and temporary exhibitions are optional; online booking adds €0.30. Normally Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 09:30–20:00, last entry 19:30; Tuesday closes except stated holiday exceptions. Check special dates and room notices. Store prohibited items as directed; no food, drink, umbrellas or sharp objects in the rooms.
Choose one work actually on display in the admitted rooms. Hold two colour relationships in mind: for example a contrast between neighbouring areas and a small colour repeated elsewhere.
After exiting, write three original lines that use those relationships in a new imagined scene. Keep this clearly your own response; do not present it as an artist’s statement or museum label.
Add a short locating note for the work and separate the two observed details from the invented response. No drawing materials, copied image or photograph is needed.

q.s: Build a small composition from an ordinary path.
st: Use an open public path in Parque de Huelin in daylight. No admission or purchase is required. The fenced dog-park refurbishment announced in September 2026 is excluded; its estimated duration does not prove completion. Respect any current work barriers and do not enter planting beds or the pond. For this outing, approach by the coastal sequence in the itinerary, allowing 45–55 min from MAM; the interior Princesa, Las Navas and Antonio Soler shortcut is excluded during unresolved renewal works. Use the full marked park-front crossing and an ordinary open gate. Afterwards retrace that crossing and allow 35–40 min on the public pedestrian coast to the Misericordia pause. Closed public connections mean another day, not a work-zone or road-lane detour.
From a place that leaves the path clear, select one plant mass and one path or pond-edge line actually visible. You do not need flowering plants, flowing water or an empty bench.
Make a small original line sketch, or write two sentences that arrange those two forms like a picture. Give one form more space and explain why.
Add two locating details and your compositional choice. Put materials away before walking on; no installation, plant collection or staged event is part of the task.

packs.title: Old Town Layers
packs.promise: Read a working market, stone gateways and gallery compositions across the historic centre.

q.s: Collect contrasts while leaving room for everyday business.
st: Visit Atarazanas around 12:00 on a nonholiday Tuesday–Saturday. The municipal listing opens Monday–Saturday 08:00–15:00; an early visit also avoids relying on a conflicting later closing. Enter only open ordinary market aisles. The June 2026 municipal conduct notice requires clear aisles and exits, no touching produce and no photo or video without permission. No purchase or trader interview is required. For the next stop, leave only by the open ordinary rear exit onto Calle Sagasta and follow the shared pedestrian-priority street and signed central passages toward Constitución; allow 15–20 min including door, delivery traffic, crossings and finding a safe public fountain view. If that exit or public passage is closed, reschedule rather than inherit this distance for an unverified front-road detour.
While circulating normally, find three contrasting product displays. Notice arrangement, texture or colour rather than evaluating traders or recording customers.
Leave the busy aisles before writing three located observations. Add one contrast between two displays; do not handle produce, block exits or seek a staged photograph.
Continue only by open public streets toward Plaza de la Constitución. Follow actual market and street controls.

q.s: Make a comparison from what is actually displayed.
st: Use valid Museo Picasso admission for the date and time: current general €13, qualifying reduced €11 with proof; under-17s and documented disabled visitors with their companions are free, alongside other published eligible categories. Advance online admission is advised to assure availability. March–June and September–October 10:00–19:00, July–August until 20:00, November–February until 18:00; last admission 30 min before closing. Sunday’s last two hours are free, subject to access and capacity; holiday rules differ. Keep the planned visit early enough for the seasonal closing, obey current bag instructions and leave time for entry.
Choose two works actually on display. Find three pairs of visible clues: one about outline, one about the relationship between forms and one about filled or empty space.
Read titles or dates only from the actual labels. Write the two identifications and the three comparisons after leaving a busy room, distinguishing observations from label facts.
Finish without seeking a particular advertised painting. Keep works untouched, your device silent and bags as staff direct; no photograph or reproduction is needed.

q.s: Use two real observations to invent something clearly fictional.
st: Start this afternoon at Museo de Málaga around 12:00 and complete the museum first. Use valid ordinary admission: documented EU nationals free, other nationalities €1.50. The current general page lists Tuesday–Saturday 09:00–21:00 and Sunday or holidays 09:00–15:00, with Monday and specified holiday closures; check the date’s actual notices. Plan to finish before 15:00 even if a shorter seasonal or special window applies. Follow cloakroom and staff instructions; reproducing holdings requires permission, so use observations and write your original response after exit. Allow separate time to reach Plaza de la Aduana and find the signed ordinary reception; the 60 min task is a focused observation and response, not the whole collection. Leave normally and regain the public Aduana approach before continuing.
Choose one object or image actually displayed and remember two visible details. Read its identification only from the actual label; do not invent a period, maker or function.

After exiting, invent a new composite object that uses those two details. Write four sentences headed with your own short fictional name, clearly describing an imagined object rather than a museum exhibit.
Add the real locating information and the two observations separately. Continue toward the ordinary Alcazaba approach only after leaving the museum normally.
